data.title: Cove
data.about:
Immerse yourself in elevated living at Cove by Imtiaz. The residential tower in Dubai Land Residence Complex features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments with various amenities. The rooftop pool has plenty of sunbeds and couches where you can unwind.

Nature's serene sands inspire the pearl white building of Cove apartments for sale. The 19 floors in The Cove by Imtiaz are dedicated to residential units, with attractions including Paradise Island on the first floor, Zenith Fitness, and various lounge areas to relax and rejuvenate.

characteristics_module.title: Meticulously Crafted Interiors Adorned with Timeless Materials and Unmatched Finishes
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Various units are available, ranging from studios to 2-bedroom apartments, with floor areas ranging from 450 sq. ft.
  • Luxury amenities, from a rooftop swimming pool to a fully-equipped gym.
  • The community offers a tranquil lifestyle, just a short distance from the city.
  • Flexible payment plan where booking starts at just 20 per cent.
  • The project is rapidly developing, with an expected completion date in the first quarter of 2027.

location_tile.title: An Ideal Choice For Those Seeking a Blend of Comfort and Connectivity.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Land Residence Complex is a vibrant residential community located in the heart of Dubailand, one of the city's most ambitious and expansive developments.

This complex offers a variety of housing options, including apartments, townhouses, and villas, catering to the diverse needs of families, professionals, and investors. The community is designed with modern living in mind, featuring wide streets, ample parking, and a variety of amenities.
 

10 minutes to Silicon Central Mall
15 minutes to Liwan
25 minutes to Warqaa Big Park
30 minutes to Downtown Dubai

seo.metaTitle: Apartments for Sale in Cove by Imtiaz
seo.metaDescription: Discover the luxury Cove by Imtiaz at Dubai Land. Explore studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments redefining your lifestyle experience.

more_info.answer: Cove by Imtiaz offers a variety of residential units, including studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments. These units feature meticulously crafted interiors adorned with timeless materials and unmatched finishes.
more_info.question: What types of units are available at Cove by Imtiaz?

more_info.answer: Residents at Cove by Imtiaz can enjoy a range of luxury amenities, including a rooftop swimming pool with sunbeds and couches, Zenith Fitness, various lounge areas, a gym, a kids' play area, a BBQ area, club room, and sauna and steam rooms.
more_info.question: What amenities can residents enjoy at Cove by Imtiaz?

more_info.answer: The starting price for units at Cove by Imtiaz is AED 525k. The payment plan is structured as 60/40, with booking starting at just 20 percent. The project is expected to be handed over in 2027.
more_info.question: What are the payment plans and starting prices for units at Cove by Imtiaz?

more_info.answer: Cove by Imtiaz is located in the Dubai Land Residence Complex, a vibrant residential community in the heart of Dubailand. Nearby attractions include Silicon Central Mall (10 minutes away), Liwan (15 minutes), Warqaa Big Park (25 minutes), and Downtown Dubai (30 minutes). The location offers a tranquil lifestyle while providing easy access to the city's key destinations.
